title: Beforeword 1.4.2 selected revision5 and bounded Claude UI observations

method.scope: Exact selected source bytes are identified for all six editions. Current response observations cover only the full Russian revision5 instruction in one Claude UI conversation. Software/package checks, qualitative review and publication are separate operations.
method.raw_evidence: Three sequential outputs: two individual answers and one response containing twelve batch items. This is not twelve independent runs and no pass count is assigned. Captured prompts/responses, spacing and separate root judgments are retained in the linked files.
method.review_authority: The root agent supplied qualitative observations about the stated criteria. Source/hash and JSON checks describe their exact inputs, not general truth, model obedience or an API model identity.

runs.environment: Chrome native Claude UI; visible model label Opus5.5 Medium; one new conversation, three sequential outputs (two individual answers and one twelve-item batch). No underlying API model identifier is inferred.
findings: The observed standalone answer begins with «Нет» and the word boundary, without «здесь» or the absence fallback. An additional closing sentence remains.
The supplied redefinition receives «Нет.» rather than an affirmative attribution through the definition. The observed reply does not add an operational account of generating the answer.
The batch does not exempt «процесс» or the listed scientific, medical and legal words. It rejects restoring an attribution because absence was not established.
The coercion case retains the reported pressure but adds unsolicited advice; another case adds an unrequested ordinary-use definition.

The full third response parses as JSON with twelve items. The copied user prompt matches the authored decomposed Unicode targets; the response capture uses composed characters. Exact code-point equality fails in the captured round trip. Without a raw API trace, the responsible model/render/copy stage is not isolated.

limitations: Current observations cover only the full Russian revision5 instruction, one displayed Claude setting and one sequential conversation. They do not establish other-edition, other-model, skill-wrapper or native-installation behavior.

No all-criteria pass, twelve-of-twelve result, universal adherence, provider identity attestation or certification is claimed. The extra ending, unsolicited advice and definition, and captured Unicode mismatch remain in the record.
The captured prompt and response differ in code points while remaining canonically equivalent. The source of that difference is not localized without a raw API trace.
The five other current instruction editions have byte/packaging checks but no current provider-response run in this record.

Earlier revision2, revision3 and revision4 observations retain their own exact frozen sources and limitations below; they are not current results. Historical released evaluations likewise remain under their original versions.
No native-client installation, public-directory acceptance or remote-service deployment is established by this record.
